# Confirmed Wallet/Core capture

Read-only reconstruction on 2026-09-10 after Nix removed the original live test evidence directory. Source manifest SHA256: `bdd981d13a71a575c3b27433fafe99d8afeeb8d7753a86a9e3fb63d5417aeabf`; all original manifest entries were verified before copying. These files capture confirmed Core transactions and selected blocks plus UTXO state at height 134. They do not recreate the lost Store, original binary metadata, prebroadcast admission/bad-witness responses, mempool state, or mining intents. The separately attributed terminal observation reports those live assertions passed. No funded rerun or Core mutation was performed for reconstruction or fixture preservation.

Only public transaction/block/UTXO captures and provenance were copied. Full wallet transaction responses and recovery script were excluded. `funding-fee-reports.json` extracts only transaction IDs and fee fields from wallet responses with their original hashes; funding fees are Core wallet reports, not independently recomputed from all funding input prevouts. Consolidation and withdrawal fees can be independently recomputed from the retained transaction chain. Selected blocks are not a complete header chain. The offline test verifies captured membership and merkle commitments, not proof of work or independent chain selection. Direct Wallet/Core evidence does not prove mixed federation authorization, Mint issuance, durable Store/outbox recovery, or historical mempool rejection.
